selection.adp: minimum of std, half_ppr, ppr in existing archive

caveat: Retrospective reconstruction, not an archived grade snapshot. Source dates are validated but webpage immutability and absence of model hindsight cannot be proved. Conservative defaults are explicitly marked. Archived ADP/projections retain their original post-season provenance caveat.

offense_normalization.method: Deterministic proxy for expected scoring environment: preseason offensive-efficiency forecast rank 1-3 => +2, 4-10 => +1, 11-22 => 0, 23-29 => -1, 30-32 => -2. Not observed 2025 scoring. Replaces batch offense_raw judgments for every player on the same cutoff-date team.
